system.description: You have received additional training in the use of Cortosis Gauntlets. You can use the Block Talent, even when not armed with a Lightsaber, provided you are wearing a Cortosis Gauntlet. If you successfully Block an attack with a Lightsaber while wearing a Cortosis Gauntlet, the attacking Lightsaber is deactivated.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
